https://www.redthreadgames.com/sound-des.description: Technical sound designer — Red Thread Games 0 Skip to Content Our story Games Jobs Newsletter Blog Our story Games Jobs Newsletter Blog Our story Games Jobs Newsletter Blog Technical sound designer — Hello Sunshine We’re Red Thread Games, the Oslo-based indie studio behind Dreamfall Chapters , Draugen , Dustborn , and Hello Sunshine . We’re looking for a technical sound designer to join the Hello Sunshine team. This is a contract position, working remotely with our development team in Oslo. We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of the game’s audio implementation: not simply creating and editing sounds, but designing the systems that determine how sound and music behave dynamically in the game. Read more about applying for a position at Red Thread Games . About the project Hello Sunshine is a single-player and co-op multiplayer survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the hot days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by AI automation gone wild. Read more about the game here . Job description Hello Sunshine is built in Unreal Engine 5, and this is a hands-on implementation role. You must be comfortable working directly in UE5 and with Blueprint-based audio workflows, collaborating closely with designers, programmers and artists to build responsive, systemic audio. You will be responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining audio systems across the game. This includes environmental and spatial audio, character and object sounds, dynamic ambience, interactive music, and the technical systems that connect audio to gameplay and the game world. You will work directly in Unreal Engine 5 and should be capable of taking audio features from initial design through implementation, debugging, optimisation and final polish. Depending on your background, the role may also include composition and music production. Experience designing and implementing adaptive or interactive music systems is particularly relevant. What we’re looking for You should have professional experience implementing audio in Unreal Engine 5, including a strong working knowledge of Unreal’s audio tools and Blueprint workflows. In particular, we’re looking for experience with the following: Designing and implementing interactive and systemic game audio in UE5. Blueprint-driven audio logic and gameplay integration. Unreal audio systems including Sound Cues, MetaSounds, attenuation, concurrency, audio volumes, modulation and submixes. Spatial and environmental audio, including positioning, attenuation, occlusion and acoustics. Surface- and material-driven audio systems, such as footsteps, impacts and movement sounds that respond appropriately to physical materials and gameplay context. Dynamic ambience and environmental soundscapes. Interactive or adaptive music systems that respond to gameplay state, location, tension and narrative context. Building reusable audio systems rather than relying entirely on individually scripted or placed sounds. Profiling, debugging and optimising audio for performance, memory and voice count. Designing systems that work reliably across PC and console hardware. Working with programmers and designers when audio behaviour needs access to gameplay systems, events or data. You should be comfortable with the broader craft of sound design: recording, sourcing, editing, processing, mixing and implementing high-quality sound effects and ambience. Experience composing and producing music is a significant advantage, particularly if you have previously worked with interactive or adaptive music. It is not, however, a requirement for the role. About you We’re looking for someone who is both creative and technically confident. You should be comfortable investigating problems independently, understanding how existing game systems work, and proposing sensible technical solutions rather than waiting for detailed implementation specifications. Because this is a remote position, you will need to communicate clearly, document your work where necessary, and be comfortable collaborating with a distributed development team. Professional game-development experience is strongly preferred, and we’d like to see examples of shipped work or playable projects demonstrating both sound design and implementation. Practical information This is a remote contract position working on Hello Sunshine with Red Thread Games. The contract duration, workload and start date will be agreed with the successful candidate. Overlap with normal European working hours will be necessary for collaboration with the development team. Applicants should include a CV or résumé and examples of relevant work. Where possible, we’d particularly like to see examples that demonstrate in-engine implementation and interactive audio systems, rather than only linear sound design or music reels. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/highdiv.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hoyoverse/2bcf6.title: Senior Audio Designer - Narrative Focus
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hoyoverse/2bcf6.location: Remote; Los Angeles, Los Angeles, United States
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hoyoverse/2bcf6.description: HoYoverse is committed to providing immersive virtual world experiences to players around the world. We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content. Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community. Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies. In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas. When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy . About the Role We are building a game where narrative is discovered through both traditional means like cutscene, and emergent gameplay elements like dialogue choices. We’re looking for someone to help craft a coherent audio story that stitches intermittent parts together to deliver a unified experience. You will be working with gameplay, narrative, and art in order to both figure out the experience that we’re want to deliver to players, as well as the internal processes used to create this non-linear story. This requires resourcefulness, clear communication, and someone who deeply understands how games feel from the player's side. You will partner with quest designers, technical designers, and engineers to build the audio functions and logic needed to deliver this experience. You will also work with and guide our in-house audio talent, elevating the audio experience through a mixture of your work and mentorship. What you will do: • Co-create the audio vision for narrative cohesion. Craft and implement dynamic, audio systems in Wwise and UE5 to make branching gameplay feel like an authored experienced. • Collaborate with designers across disciplines, including gameplay, systems, quest, and narrative to identify where story emerges through play. Propose audio solutions that surface and strengthen those moments. • Help the team identify risks and keep the audio vision moving forward even when the broader design is still taking shape. • Partner with technical personnel, including tools engineers and audio programmers. Translate the needs of systemic narrative design into clear technical requirements for our audio tools and pipelines. • Establish and document best practices for systemic audio design, creating shared language and process across the team. • Play the game relentlessly, and identify stylistic inconsistencies, dead zones, and poor transitions. Advocate for the audio experience across disciplines. What we're looking for: Required: • 5+ years of game audio design experience • A portfolio/demo reel demonstrating systemic or non-linear audio design. Show us how your audio adapts to player choice, state changes, or emergent gameplay. • Mastery of dynamic audio implementation in a modern game engine (Unreal Engine 5 strongly preferred). • Expertise with Wwise or FMOD, especially for large-scale projects with multiple systems and complex routing. • A strong personal relationship with games. You play widely, think critically about how games work, and understand how audio shapes the player's experience from the inside. • Excellent communication skills, capable of inspiring others with a creative vision and clearly explaining technical needs to engineering partners. Preferred (Nice-to-Haves): • Experience on shipped branching narrative games, open-world titles, immersive sims, or games where story emerges through systems. • Experience mentoring other audio designers or providing creative feedback. • Familiarity with the technical pipelines and tools used in quest or narrative scripting (e.g., visual scripting, dialogue systems). Why Join Us? • No one on the team has done this exact thing before. You will help navigate this challenge with a team that’s eager to explore how to deliver storytelling in this form. • You won't be handed a brief. We protect time for deep creative work and trust you to find the path forward. • Dedicated tools engineers help to build the technical capabilities required to deliver the audio experience. • Help define what systemic narrative audio means for our project and accumulate experience in this front for the next generation of designers on our team. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a link to your narrative-focused portfolio/reel . In your application, please include: A brief analysis of a game where audio successfully created cohesion across branching or emergent gameplay. What did the audio do? How do you think the systems were designed? What would you have done differently? The base pay range for this position is $135,000 to $175,000 USD per year (Los Angeles only). Actual pay is based on location and may vary depending on relevant knowledge, skills, and experience from the candidate. Total compensation may include salary, company bonuses, sign-on bonuses, relocation package, and other benefits such as: 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you and your dependents Generous paid time off 401K / RRSP plan Employer-paid life and disability insurance Team-building activities throughout the year Flexible working hours We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.
